As an Assembler, you will be responsible for accurately assembling, testing, and manufacturing complex modules and components. Experience in a technical production or assembly environment. Experience assembling and testing electronic and/or mechatronic components. Basic knowledge of electrical principles, such as resistance, induction, and

high-voltage testing, is an advantage. Good command of the English language, both written and spoken. Conversational command of the Dutch language is an advantage. An annual bonus based on the company's results. Extensive onboarding, training, and opportunities for further development. The opportunity to work in an international and highly innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines are used to produce the chips that form the foundation of virtually all modern technology. From smartphones and computers to cars and medical equipment, ASML's technology plays an important role in our everyday lives. As an Assembler, you are part of that impact. With your precision and craftsmanship, you ensure that complex modules are assembled and tested according to the highest quality standards. Every module you assemble contributes to the technology that enables the future of the semiconductor industry. Your work. Your craftsmanship. Your contribution to the technology of tomorrow. jobs.occupation: Front Office Host(ess) - 0 Hours - Park Plaza Amsterdam Airport
jobs.description:
Park Plaza Amsterdam Airport offers a dynamic and international environment just minutes from Schiphol Airport. With its convenient location, modern facilities, and excellent transport connections, the hotel is ideal for both business travellers and leisure guests seeking comfort and accessibility.

As a Front Office Host(ess), you are the face of the hotel, creating the first and last impression for our guests. You deliver warm, attentive service while ensuring smooth daily Front Office operations. From check-ins to guest requests, you play a key role in delivering a seamless and memorable guest experience. You will also be required to work night shifts, ensuring continuity of service and supporting the safety and security of the hotel during overnight hours.

The position is offered on a 0-hour contract, making it ideal for those seeking flexibility in their working schedule.

Responsibilities

• Welcome guests and ensure a smooth check-in and check-out experience

• Handle guest requests and provide personalised service throughout their stay

• Manage reservations, billing, and Front Office administration accurately

• Flexible to work night shifts, ensuring a calm and secure environment overnight

• Respond to guest inquiries via phone, email, and face-to-face communication

• Maintain professional communication with guests and colleagues

• Ensure compliance with hotel standards, procedures, and safety regulations

• Collaborate with other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience

Essential Requirements

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Flexibility to work varying shifts, including night shifts

• Guest-focused mindset with a passion for hospitality

• Ability to work independently and remain calm under pressure

• Organised with attention to detail

• Eligible to work in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience in Front Office or hospitality roles

• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)

• Flexi
